$comment: Component: contracts. Owning Team: Customer Experience Tribe (CXT). Classification: INTERNAL. Related Docs: CLAUDE.md 3 and 4.2, ADR-0013, contracts/events/topics.psv.
title: aaas.key.pressed.v1
description: Published by expression-assembler for every key press it records; a retried press (same sessionId and seq) is republished with the same eventId, never as a new event. The event precedes any task, so taskId is null and the message is keyed by sessionId, which keeps the presses of a session ordered in one partition. No service consumes it yet; it is the audit trail of the calculator input.

producer.description: The only service allowed to publish this event (contracts/events/topics.psv).

taskId.description: Always null: a key press belongs to a session, not to a task; the task is created by `=` and announced by aaas.expression.submitted.v1.

payload.description: The key press as accepted on POST /api/v1/keys.

sessionId.description: Lowercase UUID of the calculator session; also the message key.

key.description: Pressed key: a digit, `+`, `=` or `C` (CLAUDE.md section 1).

seq.description: Position of the press in the session as sent by the client; unique per session.
